name: daintree.jira
description: First-party Jira issues provider for Jira Cloud and Jira Server or Data Center 8.14+ — pick Jira issues for worktrees and use branch names that carry the issue key, while your code forge keeps pull requests and CI.
tagline: Jira issues for your worktrees, alongside your code forge

settings.label: Jira site URL
settings.description: Your Jira Cloud address, like https://acme.atlassian.net, or your Jira Server or Data Center address, like https://jira.example.com. Set it with its token in Settings → Code forge, which checks them together.

settings.label: Atlassian account email
settings.description: Jira Cloud only: the email address of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to. Set it with your site URL and API token in Settings → Code forge, which checks all three.

settings.label: Jira project key
settings.description: The key of the Jira project this project's issues live in, as it appears in issue keys (ENG for ENG-123).

credentialFields.label: API token
credentialFields.helpText: Jira Cloud: an API token from Atlassian account → Security → API tokens. Jira Server or Data Center: a personal access token from your Jira profile.
